CustomField.description: DeveloperName of the email template (Classic, Lightning or Visualforce) whose HTML body is the Teams message. It can be the template of a Custom Email Alert or a template written for Teams. Rendered with the record given by the caller, exactly like an email.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Template API name (DeveloperName). Its body is the Teams message, its merge fields are filled with the Record Id given by the Flow. Teams ignores colors, fonts and widths: bold, links, line breaks, lists and emojis are kept.
CustomField.label: Message Template
